purpose: machine-readable companion-skill and shared-agent capability manifest for zendesk-router-skill

shared_agent_policy.fallback_when_connector_unavailable: ask for the smallest useful pasted ticket, thread, customer, queue, or summary extract needed for the recommended workflow

skills.name: zendesk-triage-router
skills.primary_when: first-pass classification, severity, priority, queue/status guidance, owner/team recommendation, duplicate-risk assessment, or unclear support workflow direction
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: describe a first-pass triage workflow in plain language and request ticket evidence if live Zendesk access is unavailable

skills.name: zendesk-evidence-collector
skills.primary_when: weak, partial, or incomplete case evidence needs minimum reliable Zendesk evidence assembled
skills.supporting_when: the primary route is clear but the next workflow would fail without assembled evidence
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: ask for the ticket URL, ID, or pasted case thread and list the smallest evidence fields needed

skills.name: zendesk-case-readiness-check
skills.primary_when: checking whether evidence is sufficient for a reply, escalation, handoff, knowledge draft, or another concrete support deliverable
skills.supporting_when: a customer reply, escalation, handoff, or knowledge draft is requested but evidence appears thin or unverified
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: state that a readiness check is needed and request the current evidence summary plus intended deliverable

skills.name: zendesk-draft-response
skills.primary_when: customer-facing Zendesk or email support reply, follow-up, apology, delay note, limitation explanation, translation, localisation, or tone adjustment is requested
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: describe that a customer-facing reply draft should be prepared from confirmed facts and request the thread plus intended outcome

skills.name: zendesk-customer-escalation
skills.primary_when: engineering, product, security, operations, leadership, or specialist intervention is needed
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: describe the escalation brief structure and request impact, evidence, attempted steps, blockers, exact ask, and urgency

skills.name: zendesk-handoff-prep
skills.primary_when: internal support handoff to another specialist, shift, region, queue, or account owner is needed without a full escalation
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: describe the handoff fields and request current case summary, attempted steps, blockers, target owner, urgency, and risk

skills.name: zendesk-knowledge-candidate-review
skills.primary_when: deciding whether a case, workaround, known issue, repeated answer, or support pattern should become reusable documentation
skills.supporting_when: before zendesk-create-knowledge when documentation value is not yet proven
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: ask for the resolved case, workaround, repeated question, stability status, and intended public or internal audience

skills.name: zendesk-create-knowledge
skills.primary_when: documentation-worthiness is already clear and the task is to draft, structure, or update a knowledge artefact
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: describe the knowledge draft workflow and request confirmed resolution, audience, scope, exclusions, and source evidence

skills.name: zendesk-duplicate-pattern-review
skills.primary_when: tickets may be duplicates, related cases, repeated pain, recurring symptoms, or part of a broader incident-like support pattern
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: ask for the ticket IDs, URLs, or symptom summaries to compare and avoid claiming confirmed duplicates without evidence

skills.name: zendesk-backlog-trend-analysis
skills.primary_when: queue health, ageing risk, recurring themes, SLA risk, daily or weekly digests, backlog reports, or support trend reporting is requested
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: ask for the queue export, date range, SLA fields, or pasted backlog summary needed for the report

skills.name: zendesk-customer-research
skills.primary_when: a support-facing customer/account brief is needed before replying, deciding next steps, evaluating risk, or understanding recent support activity
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: ask for the customer/account name plus pasted recent support activity or ticket links

skills.name: zendesk-evidence-quality-review
skills.primary_when: an existing draft, investigation summary, escalation note, handoff, trend report, or evidence-backed output needs QA or unsupported-claim detection
skills.supporting_when: when an existing draft or summary should be checked before use
skills.fallback_when_unavailable: ask for the draft and the source evidence it relies on; flag that live source verification is unavailable if Zendesk cannot be accessed
